changelog:
Initial release of the client-communication-engine skill for Greek accounting correspondence.

- Drafts professional Greek-language emails and letters for client communication, including confirmations, summaries, document requests, and reminders.
- All communications require human review and approval before being sent—nothing is dispatched automatically.
- Integrates with SMTP for email delivery and supports export as PDF if email is not configured.
- Outgoing correspondence is logged per client, with full traceability of what was communicated.
- Bilingual workflow: clients receive messages in Greek; firm staff view summaries and draft previews in English.
- Includes extensive CLI commands for drafting, reviewing, editing, sending, and managing communication templates.
summary: Greek-language client correspondence — submission confirmations, summaries, document requests, reminders. Human review required before sending.
